projects.title: ElecPy — Electronics & Signal Processing CLI Tool
projects.description: CLI simulation tool covering Ohm's Law, MOSFET drain current, amplifier gain, and FFT visualization — reducing circuit calculation iteration time by 70% vs manual derivation.
projects.longDescription: Built a CLI simulation tool covering Ohm's Law, MOSFET drain current, amplifier gain, and FFT visualization, reducing circuit calculation iteration time by 70% vs manual derivation. Implemented sampling and frequency-domain analysis modules enabling sub-millisecond signal simulation, directly applicable to embedded sensor firmware validation workflows.

projects.title: EMG Pattern Recognition & Signal Processing Pipeline
projects.description: Biomedical EMG signal pipeline with notch/band-pass filtering achieving >95% noise reduction and a sliding-window feature engine feeding 91%+ accuracy classification.
projects.longDescription: Processed raw biomedical EMG signals with notch/band-pass filters achieving >95% noise reduction, directly mirroring embedded sensor signal conditioning challenges. Extracted 18 time-domain and frequency-domain features via a sliding-window engine, producing a structured dataset that fed downstream classification models with 91%+ accuracy.

projects.title: Distributed File System
projects.description: 6-component distributed file system (registry, directory, file, lock, cache servers) handling concurrent client access with zero data corruption across 200+ test scenarios.
projects.longDescription: Architected a 6-component distributed file system (registry, directory, file, lock, cache servers) handling concurrent client access with zero data corruption across 200+ test scenarios. Implemented replication and locking protocols that maintained consistency under simulated node failure, demonstrating fault-tolerance patterns applicable to embedded distributed systems.
